# Sravanthi Hospital

> Sravanthi Hospital is a gynecology, fertility, maternity, and laparoscopic/laser surgery centre in Vidya Nagar, Suryapet, Telangana, India, established in 2021. It offers Obstetrics & Gynecology, Fertility & Reproductive Medicine (infertility evaluation, IUI, IVF guidance), Maternity & Mother-Baby Care (antenatal care, high-risk pregnancy, delivery), and Laparoscopic & Laser Surgery (gallbladder/cholecystectomy, hernia and appendix repair, total laparoscopic hysterectomy, laser proctology for piles/fissure/fistula). Emergency care is available 24/7; OPD is 10:00 AM–8:00 PM daily. Primary service area: Suryapet, Telangana. Secondary service area: Telangana state, including outstation families from Kodad, Jangaon, Khammam, and Nalgonda.

Key facts:
- Address: Vidya Nagar, Suryapet, Telangana 508213, India
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 8344271555
- Doctors: Dr. T. Chaitanya Sravanthi (MBBS, MS, FRM — Obstetrics & Gynecology, Reproductive Medicine, consultations 2:00 PM–8:00 PM); Dr. Praveen Sirasani (MS, FMAS, FIAGES — General Surgery, Laparoscopic & Laser Surgery, consultations 10:00 AM–7:00 PM)
- Reported stats (hospital-provided, periodically updated): ~50,000 outpatient visits, ~3,500 successful deliveries, ~200 laparoscopic surgeries
- A dedicated Infertility Centre is expanding soon
- Site is bilingual: English and Telugu (client-side toggle, same URL)
- Full FAQ (14 questions covering timings, doctors, services, location, and booking) is on the Home page
